stage: S1-D6 one data-derived local-plane-warped RGB support candidate
candidate_membership: all original positive D1 UV/depths, exact membership and unaccepted depths retained; no growth/deletion
training_inputs: only frozen original D1 depths, original six source lists, train RGB/cameras/times; no evaluator assets or aligned Small
pretrained_model: fixed DA-V2 Small code/weights/outputs preserved; this changes RGB support matching, no model substitution
slope_fit: least squares float64 inverse depth = a*du+b*dv+c; stable row-major valid positive D1 neighbors, exclude center; (du+dv)%2==0 fit and odd held
slope_invalid_action: missing/nonfinite/rank deficient/residual failed means no proposal, retain original depth and unknown identity
plane_at_hypothesis: for reference offset(du,dv), inverse depth = 1/center_hypothesis + a*du+b*dv; original fitted intercept only for neighbor/center residual checks
plane_validity: all25 inverse depths positive finite and corresponding depths inside original camera-derived near/far, for both current and proposed hypotheses
source_support: backproject all25 reference rays under that plane; project each into source camera; bilinear sample original RGB align_corners=True; no source GT depth/visibility
support_geometry_validity: all25 samples pass original project_torch positive-z and2px image-margin geometry checks
source_patch_normalization: center raw sampled25 gray values, divide L2 norm clamped1e-5, then compare to original raw reference5x5 normalized gray
cost: clamp((1-clamp(dot(normalized_gray_patches),-1,1))/2,0,1); invalid geometry/texture/center chroma returns1; source texture measured on warped raw support
reference_and_source_validity: both reference and warped source std>=.008 and center meanRGB>.025; center chroma normalized with1e-5 clamp
depth_grid: same inclusive original camera-derived near/far inverse-depth grid; no GT alignment or relative-order interval
fit_sources: unchanged first4 of original6, best3 mean; same new cost for parent and proposal
held_sources: unchanged final2 of original6; acceptance evidence, not independent GT
proposal: minimum finite warped fit among plane-valid original192 grid hypotheses, stable first-index tie; current depth evaluated explicitly as incumbent
acceptance: finite positive different proposal; fit_new<=fit_old+1e-6; both finite held_new<=held_old+1e-6; at least one held_new<held_old-1e-6; no valid plane/grid means unchanged
controls: same preregistered D5 A_fractional/B_integer/C_slanted,64x64, same K/UV/texture/cameras/range/grid; infer slopes from analytic input depths for controls only, never copy slopes into dataset; record all minima and true costs without selecting a candidate
before_full_inference: necessary geometry/gradient/cost/degenerate/flags-off unit tests, unchanged-parent identity, CLI default off, source/input hashes, separate-process complete2+2 vs4-view save/recovery including slopes/costs/acceptance; no GT reads
evaluation: fixed membership, unaccepted-depth/source/input replay; independent same-ray static/visible-thin MAE/P90, >.05 or no-static fraction, accurate coverage with full visible/visible-thin denominators; fixed0/24/72 raw RGB and errors; slope admission is not identity or trusted normal
